async function facebookDownloader(url) {

      headers: {
        accept: '*/*',
        origin: 'https://chative.io',
        referer: 'https://chative.io/',
        'user-agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'

    })

      return {
        code: 500,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        message: 'Gagal memproses video Facebook'
      }
    }

    const data = res.data

    return {
      code: 200,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      title: data.title || '',
      hd: data.videos?.hd?.url || null,
      sd: data.videos?.sd?.url || null,
      size: {
        hd: data.videos?.hd?.size || null,
        sd: data.videos?.sd?.size || null
      },
      raw: data
    }

  } catch (e) {
    return {
      code: 500,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      message: e.message
    }
  }
}
